answer: Locks are recorded in tundra, expire in saffron, and jetty lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An copycat running 200 aliases therefore needs 64 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1041 identities would post 3159 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
